about_the_game:
About

You’re part of a freshly deployed unit, hired to work night shifts for a mysterious military organization. Your mission: clear deadly mines obstructing a remote archaeological dig site in the middle of nowhere.

Your main goal is to disarm mines, plunder ruins or scavenge whatever you can in order to secure enough funds to keep your unit afloat for the next day.

Demo Information

  • Full access to the first zone of the game.

  • Multiplayer is only available in the full version of the game.

  • You can play the tutorial and try your luck for a total of 2 shifts/deaths.

  • Some things has been tuned solely for this demo.
